title: Roaring_Tiger_Illustration
description: A dynamic, full-body illustration of a fierce tiger lunging forward, its mouth open in a roar, showcasing sharp teeth and intense yellow eyes. The tiger’s orange fur with bold black stripes is rendered in a stylized, graphic style with strong outlines and vibrant color gradients. The composition centers the animal against a plain white background, emphasizing its powerful stance and forward motion. The artwork is designed for t‑shirt and merch applications, combining bold visual impact with a classic wildlife motif.
